description.value: Gitanmaax Market is a community supermarket situated in the Gitanmaax First Nation reserve on the edge of Hazelton in the remote Skeena Country of northwestern British Columbia. It sits along the Kispiox Valley Road corridor, making it a notable resupply point for touring cyclists passing through one of BC's more isolated northern regions. The market appears to serve primarily as the local grocery anchor for the reserve community.
